# Colour Primitive

The colour primitives — the cascade’s L1 raw catalog: the active **cream** neutral ramp (decision 31 · build-time `--neutral` selection), the **lilac** brand scale, and the black/white alpha overlays. Each is a theme-fixed literal (a hex / rgba · identical on both targets) shown as a swatch; the semantic roles that compose them live on the [Colour Semantic](colour-semantic.html) page.
